title: Privacy & data
description: Download a copy of your personal data, review your cookies or delete your account (LGPD, art. 18).
exportFailed: Could not export your data. Please try again.
deleteWarning: Your personal data (name, email, phone, photo, credentials, integrations and assistant conversations) will be removed or anonymized and you will lose access. Tasks, projects and records of your organization stay with it, without your name. This cannot be undone.
deleteOwnerWarning: You own an organization. Deleting your account closes the organization and erases its data. We will log the request and complete it within 15 days; export anything you need first.
deleteExportHint: Tip: download your data before continuing.
deletePending: Request logged. We will complete it within 15 days and let you know by email.
deleteFailed: Could not delete your account. Please try again.

cookieBanner.text: We use cookies to run Flowlio and, only with your permission, for marketing. See our
cookieBanner.notSold: We do not sell your personal data.
cookieBanner.title: Cookie preferences
cookieBanner.intro: Choose which cookie categories you allow. You can change this at any time from "Cookie Settings" in the footer.
cookieBanner.necessaryDesc: Required for login, security and core functionality. Cannot be disabled.
cookieBanner.analyticsDesc: Helps us understand how Flowlio is used so we can improve it.
cookieBanner.marketingDesc: Meta Pixel — measures ad performance. Only loads if you enable it.

admin.title: LGPD requests
admin.description: Data subject requests that need manual action (organization owners asking for deletion). Legal deadline: 15 days.
admin.hint: Before completing an owner's request, delete the organization under Companies. Completing anonymizes the requester's account.

exportOrganizationHint: Downloads everything your organization stores in Flowlio (projects, tasks, clients, invoices...) as a JSON file. Use it as a backup or to take your data to another tool.

import.title: Import data
import.description: Bring leads, clients, projects and tasks from Monday, Trello, Asana or any Excel/CSV spreadsheet.
import.fileHint: In Monday: board menu > Export > Excel. Up to {{max}} rows per file.
import.noHeader: We could not find the header row in this spreadsheet.
import.unreadable: Could not read the file. Save it as .xlsx or .csv and try again.
import.tooMany: The file has more than {{max}} rows. Split it into parts.
import.failed: The import failed. Nothing was saved.
import.extraTasks: Checked columns become task custom fields (typed from their values) and show in the List.
import.extraContacts: Checked columns are saved on the record and show on each lead or client page.

dataAdmin.title: Organization backups
dataAdmin.description: Daily copy of each organization (the last 7 are kept). Restore one organization without touching the others. Inactive organizations are deleted after 90 days, with a warning on day 75.
dataAdmin.autoDeleteOff: Automatic deletion: off (enable with ORG_AUTO_DELETE_ENABLED=true). Dates below are informational only.
dataAdmin.restoreHint: Restoring brings projects, tasks, clients, invoices and other data back to the backup. Team access, billing and audit history are not changed. Before restoring, the current state is saved as a backup.
dataAdmin.restored: Organization restored. The previous state was saved as a backup.
dataAdmin.failed: The operation failed. Nothing was changed.
